prompt: Create a clean editorial poster portrait of a beautiful Japanese woman, Anri Okita, standing centered against an off-white studio background, facing the camera with a soft confident smile. She has shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair parted to one side, pale luminous skin, subtle natural makeup, small hoop earrings, and a delicate necklace with a tiny circular pendant. She wears a ribbed dusty-rose camisole with thin straps and high-waisted light beige jeans, hands held behind her back, cropped from head to upper thighs. Use a mostly monochrome black-and-white photographic look with only the camisole softly colorized in muted rose and the jeans lightly warm beige. Behind her, place oversized bold Japanese typography in distressed black ink: exactly 4 large visible characters total, with one giant brush-calligraphy character on the left reading 沖, two huge block characters on the right reading 田 杏梨, and one small printed signature at bottom left reading 沖田. The typography should be partially hidden behind the figure, with rough ink texture, grunge speckles, and strong graphic contrast. Composition: square 4:3-ish poster crop, minimal background, sharp realistic portrait lighting, high-end magazine cover aesthetic, no extra props, no watermark, no additional text.
